description: Change the status of many alerts at once. Select EITHER an explicit `ids` list (max 1000) OR `all_matching: true` with the `filter_*` fields, which mirror `list_alerts`. Alerts already in a state the transition cannot leave are skipped rather than failing the call, so the response reports `updated` and `skipped` counts — compare `updated + skipped` against the selection size to see how many were no-ops. Prefer `update_alert_status` for a single alert.

all_matching.description: Apply to every alert matching the `filter_*` fields instead of an id list. With no filters this means EVERY alert in the organization, so filter first and confirm the scope with `get_alert_stats` using the same filters.

filter_campaign_id.description: Only with `all_matching`: restrict to one campaign.

filter_country_codes.description: Only with `all_matching`: restrict to these ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries.

filter_date_from.description: Only with `all_matching`: inclusive lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD) on alert creation.

filter_date_to.description: Only with `all_matching`: inclusive upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD) on alert creation.

filter_policy_set_ids.description: Only with `all_matching`: restrict to alerts raised by any of these policy sets.

filter_status.description: Only with `all_matching`: restrict to alerts currently in this status.

filter_tag_slugs.description: Only with `all_matching`: restrict to alerts carrying any of these tag slugs.

filter_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the filter date bounds. REQUIRED by the API whenever either date is set.

ids.description: Explicit alert UUIDs, at most 1000 per call. Mutually exclusive with `all_matching`.

status.description: Status to move the selected alerts to.

name: bulk_update_alert_status
title: Bulk Update Alert Status
